At 1 the project depends on a single person. Bots are left out; one person with several accounts or addresses counts more than once.

metrics.name: Organizational Diversity
metrics.explanation: Organisations are told apart by the email domain of the latest 300 commits of the last 12 months (264 commits by people, after the .mailmap) and, for a personal or hidden address, by the company on the author's public profile. Only these counts are kept, no names, addresses or companies; an organisation is named only when several authors share it.
